name: Mama o Ahegao ni Shite Ageru! ~Hahaoya Ahegao Harabote  Shussan~
original_name: ママをアヘ顔にしてあげる! ～母親アヘ顔腹ボテ出産～
source:
One day, Shou, a boy who loves his mother, Mio, spots her masturbation scene.
He can no longer withhold his sexual desire, puts her in restraint and violates her.
However, that was Mio's secret wish as well.
Now that they know about their feelings, they start falling into a forbidden world.
